address: rue du Fond des Naux 7, Lacuisine, 6821, Belgium
bio: The sleepy village of Lacuisine makes the perfect base camp to explore the Ardennes. Don’t miss Ronny and Christel’s stylish establishment which combines a friendly vibe with modern comforts. The chef cooks regional produce, most of which from scratch, with lashings of generosity. For example, you may taste a terrine of foie gras with smoked duck magret or a fillet of plaice with a pastis-flavoured jus. The enticing range of set menus means that there is something to suit every palate. Even better, stay overnight and jump into the pool before or after breakfast next morning....
